name: Kubernetes
description: Kubernetes clusters through kubectl: any context of the kubeconfig without switching the global one, apps with their health, workloads, pods, services and jobs, actions, logs and shells in terminal tabs, and a status tool for agents.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the panel re-reads the shown namespace while it is visible.

agentTools.name: status
agentTools.title: Kubernetes status
agentTools.description: What is unhealthy in a namespace of the kubeconfig's current context: apps with problems, workloads not rolled out, failing pods with their reason, failed jobs and recent warning events. Read-only; no secrets or logs.
